title: Power Capital: Services
description: Fractional CFO services from Power Capital: cash flow forecasting, budgets, FP&A, capital raising, controls, KPI dashboards, and turnaround support.
ogDescription: Internal audit, FP&A, capital raising, and accounting governance — fractional CFO services for capital-intensive builds.

blocks.heading: Strategy, controls, and capital.
blocks.body: Your part-time CFO — running your finance strategy alongside your team.

cards.title: Internal Audit & Controls
cards.body: Framework to pinpoint missing controls, redundant processes, or compliance risk — making you audit-ready.

cards.title: Financial Systems & FP&A
cards.body: Designing the reporting infrastructure and FP&A cadence that let you trust the numbers and plan ahead with confidence.

cards.title: Budgets & Burn-Rate Control
cards.body: An operating budget you actually use, budget-versus-actual reviews, and spending guardrails that protect your runway.

cards.title: Financial Models & Business Plans
cards.body: Data-driven plans for growth, pricing, new locations, or product lines — with realistic revenue assumptions you can defend.

cards.title: Capital Raising
cards.body: Investor-ready financials, pitch-deck numbers, lender materials, SBA and bank loan preparation, and support through due diligence.

cards.title: KPI Dashboards & Board Reporting
cards.body: Key performance indicators that matter for your business.

cards.title: Accounting Policy & Governance
cards.body: Compliance policies across data center CapEx capitalization rules, lease accounting, and revenue recognition, ensuring institutional audit readiness and protecting capital deployment.

cards.title: Cash Flow Forecasting
cards.body: Rolling 13-week and 12-month forecasts so you see a cash gap months before it arrives, with a concrete plan to close it.

blocks.heading: Gain high-level leadership across four pillars.

items.title: Strategic Analysis & Planning
items.body: Translate goals into financial plans, scenarios, and the roadmap to get there.

items.title: Investment & Capital Structure
items.body: Decide how to fund growth — debt, equity, or reinvestment — and structure it on good terms.

items.title: Stakeholder Communication
items.body: Board decks, investor updates, and lender conversations, handled by someone who's sat on both sides.

items.title: Leadership & Decision-Making
items.body: A steady hand on the big calls — hiring, pricing, expansion, and everything with a dollar sign attached.

blocks.heading: Pick the level of CFO support you need today.

plans.name: CFO Advisory
plans.summary: A senior finance partner on call for the big decisions.
plans.fit: owner-led businesses that want a sounding board.

plans.name: Project CFO
plans.summary: A focused engagement with a clear finish line.
plans.fit: a specific event in the next 3–6 months.

plans.name: Fractional CFO
plans.summary: Your part-time CFO, running finance alongside your team.

blocks.heading: Not sure which fits? Let's figure it out together.
blocks.body: Send us a message and we'll help you find the right level of support for where your business is today.
